full_job_description: About the job At Nucleus, great AI products depend on infrastructure that is reliable, adaptable, and built to evolve with ambition. We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure to build and maintain the core systems that power Nucleus AI products. This role is focused on the infrastructure beneath the product experience: backend services, deployment systems, reliability foundations, and the shared platforms that allow teams to ship quickly without compromising quality.You will work across service architecture, production operations, and internal platform capabilities—helping ensure that our products are stable, secure, and ready to scale.What you’ll do Build and maintain core infrastructure and backend services that support Nucleus AI products in production.Improve deployment systems, developer workflows, and service foundations that help product teams move faster with confidence.Strengthen reliability, observability, and operational tooling across product-facing infrastructure.Design and evolve shared systems for service communication, configuration, secrets management, and production readiness.Partner closely with product engineers, frontend teams, and platform teams to support new launches and ongoing scale.Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements across core systems.Help define infrastructure standards and best practices around availability, security, and maintainability.Build internal tooling and automation that reduce operational overhead and improve engineering leverage. What we’re looking for Strong experience building production backend systems, infrastructure platforms, or reliability-oriented software.Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD systems, and modern service deployment practices.Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and incident management in distributed systems.Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages such as Go, Python, Java, Rust, or similar.Comfort working across product and infrastructure boundaries, with an eye for practical tradeoffs.Solid understanding of service architecture, scalability, and operational excellence.A builder’s mindset: able to improve foundations while supporting fast-moving product teams.Interest in AI products and the infrastructure challenges that come with serving intelligent systems at scale. Why NucleusNucleus is building AI systems that people and organizations rely on for meaningful work. That kind of trust is earned through infrastructure that is resilient, well-designed, and ready for constant evolution.In this role, you’ll help create the technical foundations behind our products—systems that make ambitious ideas shippable, dependable, and scalable. If you want to work on infrastructure that directly shapes how frontier AI reaches users, we’d love to hear from you.

full_job_description: About the job At Nucleus, we’re building AI products that turn frontier intelligence into useful, reliable, real-world systems. Behind every great product experience is a backend platform that is fast, secure, and built to scale - and that’s where this role comes in.We’re hiring a Backend Engineer in Product Platform to design and build the backend systems and APIs that power Nucleus’s AI products. This is a high-impact engineering role for someone who cares deeply about system design, product quality, and the infrastructure foundations that make advanced AI experiences dependable in production.About the roleAs a Backend Engineer on our product platform, you will build and evolve the services, APIs, and core backend architecture that support our user-facing AI products. You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and cross-functional engineering teams to create systems that are scalable, secure, and reliable from the start.This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning backend problems end to end: from API design and service implementation to performance, observability, and production reliability. You should be comfortable balancing product speed with sound engineering judgment, and excited to help shape the backend foundations behind a growing AI platform.What you’ll do Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power Nucleus’s AI products and platform capabilities.Partner closely with product and frontend teams to translate product requirements into clean, reliable backend systems.Develop backend architectures that support evolving product needs while maintaining strong performance and maintainability.Improve system reliability through thoughtful service design, observability, monitoring, debugging, and incident response practices.Build with security in mind, applying best practices across authentication, authorization, data handling, secrets management, and service communication.Optimize backend systems for performance, scalability, and operational efficiency in production environments.Contribute to API design, service contracts, data models, and engineering standards that improve developer velocity across teams.Work across the stack of internal platform services and product infrastructure to help ship polished, dependable user experiences. What we’re looking for Strong software engineering experience in backend development, ideally in product or platform-oriented environments.Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript.Experience designing and building REST APIs, backend services, and distributed systems used in production.Solid understanding of scalability, reliability, security, and performance considerations in modern backend systems.Experience working with databases, caching layers, message queues, or event-driven architectures.Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and deployment environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with product managers, frontend engineers, and other cross-functional partners.Good judgment, strong ownership, and a bias toward building systems that are both practical and durable. What makes Nucleus differentNucleus is building AI systems with real-world utility, which means our engineering foundations matter. We care about product quality, reliability, and thoughtful execution — not just prototypes, but systems people can trust.You’ll join a team that values technical depth, clear thinking, and close collaboration across engineering and product. The work is ambitious, but grounded: building the backend platform that helps advanced AI become usable, secure, and dependable at scale.If you’re excited by the idea of building the backend systems that help AI products perform reliably in the real world, we’d love to hear from you.
